premises.text: Person-to-person payments are a significant part of financial transactions.
premises.evidence_span: in the United States in 2010, that accounted for $865 billion worth of transactions.

premises.text: Most person-to-person payments are made using cash and checks.
premises.evidence_span: 70% of those transactions was using cash and check.

premises.text: The current process for helping someone pay a bill is cumbersome and lacks visibility.
premises.evidence_span: the way it works right now is if I want to help someone pay their bill, they've got to contact me, they've got to tell me how much the bill is for, when they need the money, I've got to send it to them, cash, check, they've got to get it, they've got to bank it, then they've got to send it on to the biller.

premises.text: PayTap allows users to collaborate and contribute towards a bill with money going directly to the biller.
premises.evidence_span: we allow people to collaborate and contribute towards a bill with the money going directly to the biller.

premises.text: Users can pay bills without needing to sign up for an account.
premises.evidence_span: she's able to go to PayTap without signing up for an account.

premises.text: PayTap protects users' financial information during transactions.
premises.evidence_span: no one gets to see my financial information, not her roommates, not my daughter.

premises.text: PayTap provides notifications to users when payments are made.
premises.evidence_span: when the payment is finished, my daughter is alerted, her roommates are alerted.

premises.text: PayTap allows for recurring payments to be set up.
premises.evidence_span: we can set up things like recurring payments.

premises.text: PayTap can integrate with online merchants for payment processing.
premises.evidence_span: we're rolling out PayTap as a web app and a Facebook app.

premises.text: PayTap can disrupt traditional financial institutions and money transmitters.
premises.evidence_span: we have a chance here to drive the next evolution of people online to make their payments.

premises.text: No other service allows users to collaborate on payments directly to the biller.
premises.evidence_span: none allow you to collaborate together and contribute where the money goes directly to the biller.

value.text: PayTap simplifies and secures the process of shared payments.
value.evidence_span: we're the definition of elegant organisation for shared payments.
